# src/providers/

LLM provider abstraction layer. BaseProvider implements OpenAI-compatible API client pattern. ProviderRegistry instantiates provider-specific classes from Config.

## Contents

### [base.ts](./base.ts)

`BaseProvider` class — abstract base for all LLM providers. Implements `isHealthy()` health check, `chatCompletion()` non-streaming requests, `chatCompletionStream()` SSE parsing. Protected `getHeaders()` builds auth headers.

### [index.ts](./index.ts)

`ProviderRegistry` class — factory that instantiates providers from Config. Maps names to classes via `PROVIDER_CLASSES`. Exports `GroqProvider`, `TogetherProvider`, `CerebrasProvider`, `SambanovaProvider`, `OpenRouterProvider`, `GenericProvider` (all extend `BaseProvider`).

## Architecture

**Request Flow**: `ProviderRegistry.get()` → provider instance → `BaseProvider.chatCompletion()` or `chatCompletionStream()`. All providers share OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint format.

**Provider Selection**: `ProviderRegistry.findByModel(model)` filters registered providers via `p.supportsModel(model)`. Each provider's `config.models` array determines model availability.

**Instantiation**: Registry constructor iterates `config.providers`, skips disabled entries or missing `api_key`, constructs via `PROVIDER_CLASSES[name]` lookup or `GenericProvider` fallback.

## Behavioral Contracts

### SSE Stream Parsing (chatCompletionStream)

- Line delimiter: `\n`
- Comment lines: start with `:`, skipped
- Data lines: start with `data: `, JSON parsed
- Termination marker: `` `data: [DONE]` `` (exact match)
- Partial line buffering: incomplete lines accumulated across chunks
- Parse errors: `getLogger().warn()` with message, line skipped (stream continues)

### HTTP Error Format

```text
Provider ${name} returned ${status}: ${body}
```

### Request Body Transformations

- `provider` and `cache` fields stripped from request before sending
- `stream: false` forced for `chatCompletion()`
- `stream: true` forced for `chatCompletionStream()`

### Response Injection

All responses include `provider: this.name` field.

## API Surface

**Exported Classes**:

- `BaseProvider` — extend for new provider implementations
- `ProviderRegistry` — instantiate in application bootstrap

**Registry Methods**:

- `get(name: string): Provider | undefined`
- `getAll(): Provider[]`
- `getNames(): string[]`
- `has(name: string): boolean`
- `findByModel(model: string): Provider[]`

**Constructor Map** (`PROVIDER_CLASSES`):
| Key | Class |
|-----|-------|
| `groq` | `GroqProvider` |
| `together` | `TogetherProvider` |
| `cerebras` | `CerebrasProvider` |
| `sambanova` | `SambanovaProvider` |
| `openrouter` | `OpenRouterProvider` |

Unlisted keys instantiate `GenericProvider` with dynamic name.
